## What a program may change
- A1 only: append the equipment name after 'CS File of '.
- Rows 2-7 (header + Vendor / Product Information block): never touch. B4:B7 stay 'NA' (vendor fills them).
- Rows 8 onward: the template is a FIXED 71-row skeleton (empty merged section rows listed above, bordered body rows between them). A real URS has a different number of rows, so the safe method is: use row 8 as the style prototype for section rows and row 9 as the style prototype for body rows, un-merge/clear rows 8+, then write as many rows as the URS needs (reference/builder.js does this).
- Column C (Vendor Feedback) stays empty. Column D is unused: write nothing there.

## Validation
`python3 reference/validate_template.py CS.xlsx output.xlsx` -> exit code 1 if rows 1-7, widths, freeze panes, zoom, orientation, merged title, or row styles change. Result on the Biosafety Cabinet test: sections=5 body_rows=56 errors=0.
